evidence.quote:
No blocking
call, and no lost work

observations.why: Two negated outcomes set in deliberate contrast within one frame — what the contract avoids versus what it preserves — a performed antithesis, not incidental phrasing.

evidence.quote:
the agent either polls the run or
gets the reaction piggybacked on a later call

observations.why: Two matched alternatives presented in parallel grammatical structure (either X … or Y) doing argumentative work — a performed parallelism, not a plain list.
